# dbpeek docs — LLM context

dbpeek is a privacy-first SQL client that runs locally from a single npx command.
No credentials are stored. No data leaves localhost. No telemetry.

## Documentation sections

- Getting started: installation, quickstart, connection strings, permission modes
- Editor: schema-aware autocomplete, multi-tab, parameterized queries, format SQL, query cancellation
- Schema browsing: explorer, column statistics, DDL viewer, pin tables, ERD diagrams
- Results: grid, sorting & filtering, value viewer, copy cell, export, charts
- Query analysis: EXPLAIN plans, query history, multi-statement, session report, smart empty state
- Data modification (--write/--full): inline editing, CSV/JSON import, table editor, data diff
- Reference: CLI flags, keyboard shortcuts, supported databases, troubleshooting, FAQ
- Advanced: architecture, privacy model, credential audit, contributing

## Key facts

- Run: npx dbpeek <connection-string>
- Dialects: PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, MSSQL
- Permission modes: read-only (default), --write, --full
- License: MIT
- Repo: https://github.com/alvinwquach/dbpeek
- Docs: https://dbpeek.com/docs
